meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证分析方法是否符合法规要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在制药或生物分析实验室中验证分析方法的合规性。
copy.tagline_en: Validate analytical methods for regulatory compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate analytical methods in pharma or bioanalysis labs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按所选法规框架（如ICH Q2(R2)、ICH M10等）规划分析方法的验证、确认或转移，生成验证方案，并调用内置脚本计算线性、准确度/精密度、检出限、方法比较等统计量，输出报告表格；脚本只报告结果不做“是否合格”的结论。
howto.when: 当提到“方法验证”、“ICH Q2”、“USP 1225”等关键词，或询问某个分析程序是否适合其预期用途（如验证方案、接受标准、线性、方法转移）时触发。

say.text: 请按ICH Q2(R2)为这个HPLC方法生成验证方案。
检查calibration.csv这份标准曲线的线性是否成立。
用TOST检验这两个方法的等效性。

howto.what_en: Claude plans and documents validation/verification/transfer per selected framework, generates protocol, runs scripts for linearity, accuracy/precision, limits, and method comparison. Outputs tables; scripts never conclude.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions method-validation keywords (e.g. "method validation", "ICH Q2", "USP 1225") or asks whether an analytical procedure is fit for its intended purpose.

say_en.text: Generate a validation protocol for this HPLC assay per ICH Q2(R2).
say_en.note: Claude outputs a protocol skeleton with blank acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Check whether calibration.csv shows linearity over the range.
say_en.note: Claude runs check_response.py and reports lack-of-fit and back-calc errors.

say_en.text: Test equivalence of the two methods with TOST.
say_en.note: Claude runs compare_methods.py giving TOST p-value and 90% CI.
